# Nuqta – Istanbul's Arabic Event Hub

> Nuqta (nuqta.ist) is a bilingual (Arabic/English) event discovery and management platform
> connecting the Arab community in Istanbul, Turkey with workshops, bazaars, concerts, and more.
> Founded in 2024, Nuqta serves as the central meeting point for Arabic-speaking residents
> and visitors looking to discover cultural events, or for organizers wanting to manage and
> promote their events professionally.

## About
- [About Nuqta](https://nuqta.ist/en/about): Our mission, story, and why we built Nuqta
- [Contact Us](https://nuqta.ist/en/contact): Get in touch with the Nuqta team
- [Privacy Policy](https://nuqta.ist/en/privacy): How we handle and protect user data

## For Event Organizers
- [For Vendors / Organizers](https://nuqta.ist/en/for-vendors): Professional event management platform for Arab organizers in Turkey
- [Pricing Plans](https://nuqta.ist/en/for-vendors#pricing): Starter (Free, 1 event), Growth (999 TRY/mo, 3 events), Professional (1999 TRY/mo, unlimited)

## Events
- [Browse Events](https://nuqta.ist/en): Discover upcoming Arabic community events in Istanbul
- [Event Categories](https://nuqta.ist/en): Workshops, Bazaars, Music & Concerts, Art & Exhibitions, Food & Other

## Key Facts
- **Name**: Nuqta (نقطة — meaning "point" or "dot" in Arabic)
- **Founded**: 2024
- **Location**: Istanbul, Turkey
- **Languages**: Arabic, English
- **Target Audience**: Arabic-speaking community in Istanbul and Turkey
- **Platform Type**: Web-based event marketplace with ticketing and booking management
- **Contact Email**: nuqta.events@gmail.com
- **Social**: [@nuqta_ist on Instagram](https://instagram.com/nuqta_ist), [@nuqta_ist on Twitter](https://twitter.com/nuqta_ist)
